verses.kjv: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
verses.modern: Paul, an apostle — not appointed by men nor through any man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead—

verses.kjv: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
verses.modern: and all the brothers with me, to the churches of Galatia:

verses.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.modern: Grace and peace to You from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.kjv: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
verses.modern: who gave Himself for our sins in order to deliver us from this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

verses.kjv: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.modern: to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.kjv: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
verses.modern: I marvel that You are so soon removed from Him who called You into the grace of Christ to another gospel—

verses.kjv: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
verses.modern: which is really no gospel at all. Evidently some people are throwing You into confusion and are trying to distort the gospel of Christ.

verses.kjv: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
verses.modern: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel other than the one we preached to You, let Him be eternally condemned!

verses.kjv: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
verses.modern: As we have already said, so now I say again: if anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to what You received, let Him be eternally condemned!

verses.kjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
verses.modern: Am I now trying to win the approval of men, or of God? Am I trying to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I would not be a servant of Christ.

verses.kjv: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
verses.modern: I want You to know, brothers, that the gospel I preached is not of human origin.

verses.kjv: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by a revelation from Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
verses.modern: For You have heard of my former way of life in Judaism — how intensely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.

verses.kjv: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
verses.modern: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my own age among my people and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

verses.kjv: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,
verses.modern: But when God, Who set me apart from birth and called me by His grace, was pleased

verses.kjv: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
verses.modern: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, my immediate response was not to consult any human being.

verses.kjv: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
verses.modern: I did not go up to Jerusalem to see those who were apostles before me, but I went into Arabia and later returned to Damascus.

verses.kjv: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
verses.modern: Then after three years, I went up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas and stayed with Him fifteen days.

verses.kjv: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.
verses.modern: I saw none of the other apostles — only James, the Lord's brother.

verses.kjv: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
verses.modern: I assure You before God that what I am writing You is no lie.

verses.kjv: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
verses.modern: Then I went to Syria and Cilicia.

verses.kjv: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
verses.modern: I was personally unknown to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.

verses.kjv: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
verses.modern: They only heard the report: "The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy."

verses.kjv: And they glorified God in me.
verses.modern: And they praised God because of me.

chapters.summary: Paul marvels that the Galatians are so quickly turning to a different gospel and pronounces a curse on anyone who preaches another gospel than what they received. He defends his apostleship, declaring that the gospel he preaches came not from man but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
verses.modern: Then after fourteen years, I went up again to Jerusalem, this time with Barnabas. I took Titus along also.

verses.kjv: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
verses.modern: I went in response to a revelation and set before them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles. But I did this privately with those held in high esteem, for fear that I was running or had run my race in vain.

verses.kjv: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
verses.modern: Yet not even Titus, who was with me, was compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a Greek.

verses.kjv: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
verses.modern: This matter arose because some false brothers had been secretly brought in. They crept in to spy out the freedom we have in Christ Jesus, wanting to bring us into slavery.

verses.kjv: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
verses.modern: We did not give in to them for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel might remain with You.

verses.kjv: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) they in conference added nothing to me:
verses.modern: As for those who were held in high esteem — whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism — they added nothing to my message.

verses.kjv: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
verses.modern: On the contrary, they recognized that I had been entrusted with the task of preaching the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been to the circumcised.

verses.kjv: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
verses.modern: For God Who worked through Peter as an apostle to the circumcised also worked through me as an apostle to the Gentiles.

verses.kjv: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
verses.modern: James, Cephas, and John, those regarded as pillars, gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship when they recognized the grace given to me. They agreed that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised.

verses.kjv: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
verses.modern: All they asked was that we should continue to remember the poor, the very thing I had been eager to do all along.

verses.kjv: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
verses.modern: But when Peter came to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

verses.kjv: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
verses.modern: For before certain men came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles. But when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself, fearing those of the circumcision group.

verses.kjv: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
verses.modern: The other Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that by their hypocrisy even Barnabas was led astray.

verses.kjv: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
verses.modern: When I saw that they were not acting in line with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas in front of them all: "You are a Jew, yet you live like a Gentile and not like a Jew. How is it, then, that you force Gentiles to follow Jewish customs?"

verses.kjv: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
verses.modern: We who are Jews by birth and not sinful Gentiles

verses.kjv: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
verses.modern: know that a person is not justified by works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ. So we also have believed in Christ Jesus, in order to be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law — because by works of the law no flesh will be justified.

verses.kjv: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
verses.modern: But if, in seeking to be justified in Christ, we ourselves are also found to be sinners, does that mean Christ promotes sin? Absolutely not!

verses.kjv: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I prove myself a transgressor.
verses.modern: If I rebuild what I tore down, I prove that I am a transgressor.

verses.kjv: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
verses.modern: For through the law I died to the law, so that I might live to God.

verses.kjv: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
verses.modern: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I now live in the body I live by faith in the Son of God, Who loved me and gave Himself for me.

verses.kjv: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
verses.modern: I do not set aside the grace of God. For if righteousness could be gained through the law, Christ died for nothing!

chapters.summary: Paul recounts going up to Jerusalem where the apostles added nothing to his gospel, and how he withstood Peter to his face at Antioch for withdrawing from the Gentiles. He declares that a man is not justified by the works of the law but by the faith of Jesus Christ, and that he is crucified with Christ — the life he now lives, he lives by the faith of the Son of God.

verses.kjv: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
verses.modern: O foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched You, that You should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ has been clearly set forth, crucified among You?

verses.kjv: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.modern: I would like to learn just one thing from You: Did You receive the Spirit by works of the law, or by believing what You heard?

verses.kjv: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
verses.modern: Are You so foolish? After beginning by means of the Spirit, are You now trying to finish by means of the flesh?

verses.kjv: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
verses.modern: Have You experienced so much in vain — if it really was in vain?

verses.kjv: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.modern: So again I ask: does God give You His Spirit and work miracles among You by the works of the law, or by Your believing what You heard?

verses.kjv: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
verses.modern: So also: "Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to Him for righteousness."

verses.kjv: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
verses.modern: Understand, then, that those who have faith are children of Abraham.

verses.kjv: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
verses.modern: Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and announced the gospel in advance to Abraham: "All nations will be blessed through you."

verses.kjv: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
verses.modern: So those who rely on faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.

verses.kjv: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
verses.modern: For all who rely on works of the law are under a curse, as it is written: "Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law."

verses.kjv: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
verses.modern: Clearly no one who relies on the law is justified before God, because "the righteous will live by faith."

verses.kjv: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
verses.modern: The law is not based on faith; on the contrary, it says, "The person who does these things will live by them."

verses.kjv: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
verses.modern: Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us — for it is written: "Cursed is every one that hangs on a tree."

verses.kjv: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.modern: He redeemed us in order that the blessing given to Abraham might come to the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.

verses.kjv: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
verses.modern: Brothers and sisters, let me take an example from everyday life. Just as no one can set aside or add to a human covenant that has been duly established, so it is in this case.

verses.kjv: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
verses.modern: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. Scripture does not say "and to seeds," meaning many people, but "and to Your seed," meaning one person, who is Christ.

verses.kjv: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
verses.modern: What I mean is this: the law, introduced 430 years later, does not set aside the covenant previously established by God and thus do away with the promise.

verses.kjv: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
verses.modern: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on the promise. But God in His grace gave it to Abraham through a promise.

verses.kjv: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
verses.modern: Why then was the law given? It was added because of transgressions until the Seed to whom the promise referred had come. The law was given through angels and entrusted to a mediator.

verses.kjv: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
verses.modern: A mediator, however, implies more than one party; but God is one.

verses.kjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
verses.modern: Is the law, therefore, opposed to the promises of God? Not at all! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come by the law.

verses.kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
verses.modern: But Scripture has shut up everyone under sin, so that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

verses.kjv: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.modern: Before this faith came, we were held in custody under the law, locked up until the faith that was to come would be revealed.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.modern: Therefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

verses.kjv: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
verses.modern: But after faith has come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

verses.kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.modern: You are all children of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.modern: For all of You who were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

verses.kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.modern: There is neither Jew nor Greek, neither slave nor free, neither male nor female, for You are all one in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
verses.modern: If You belong to Christ, then You are Abraham's seed and heirs according to the promise.

chapters.summary: Paul rebukes the foolish Galatians, asking whether they received the Spirit by the works of the law or by the hearing of faith. He argues that the law was a schoolmaster to bring us to Christ, that the promise to Abraham came through faith, and that in Christ there is neither Jew nor Greek, bond nor free, male nor female — all are one in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
verses.modern: What I am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a servant, even though he is the owner of everything.

verses.kjv: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
verses.modern: He is subject to guardians and trustees until the time set by his father.

verses.kjv: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
verses.modern: So also, when we were children, we were in slavery under the basic principles of the world.

verses.kjv: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
verses.modern: But when the time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,

verses.kjv: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
verses.modern: to redeem those under the law, that we might receive adoption as sons.

verses.kjv: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
verses.modern: Because You are His sons, God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, the Spirit Who calls out, "Abba, Father."

verses.kjv: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.modern: Therefore You are no longer a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

verses.kjv: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
verses.modern: Formerly, when You did not know God, You were enslaved to those who by nature are not gods.

verses.kjv: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
verses.modern: But now that You know God — or rather are known by God — how is it that You are turning back to those weak and miserable forces? Do You wish to be enslaved by them all over again?

verses.kjv: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
verses.modern: You are observing special days, months, seasons, and years.

verses.kjv: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
verses.modern: I fear for You, that somehow I have wasted my efforts on You.

verses.kjv: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
verses.modern: I plead with You, brothers and sisters, become like me, for I became like You. You did me no wrong.

verses.kjv: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
verses.modern: As You know, it was because of an illness that I first preached the gospel to You.

verses.kjv: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
verses.modern: And my temptation which was in my flesh You did not despise or reject; but You received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
verses.modern: Where, then, is Your blessing? I can testify that, if You could have done so, You would have torn out Your eyes and given them to me.

verses.kjv: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
verses.modern: Have I now become Your enemy by telling You the truth?

verses.kjv: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
verses.modern: Those people are zealous to win You over, but for no good. What they want is to alienate You from us, so that You may have zeal for them.

verses.kjv: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.modern: It is good to be zealous, provided the purpose is good, and to be so always and not only when I am with You.

verses.kjv: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
verses.modern: My dear children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in You—

verses.kjv: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
verses.modern: how I wish I could be with You now and change my tone, because I am perplexed about You!

verses.kjv: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
verses.modern: Tell me, You who want to be under the law, are You not aware of what the law says?

verses.kjv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
verses.modern: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.

verses.kjv: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
verses.modern: His son by the slave woman was born in the ordinary way; but his son by the free woman was born as the result of a divine promise.

verses.kjv: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
verses.modern: These things are being taken figuratively: the women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children who are to be slaves — this is Hagar.

verses.kjv: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
verses.modern: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that now is, and is in bondage with her children.

verses.kjv: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
verses.modern: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, and she is our mother.

verses.kjv: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
verses.modern: For it is written: "Rejoice, you who are childless. Break forth and cry aloud, you who are not in labor. For the desolate woman has more children than she who has a husband."

verses.kjv: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
verses.modern: Now you, brothers and sisters, like Isaac, are children of promise.

verses.kjv: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
verses.modern: At that time the son born in the ordinary way persecuted the son born by the power of the Spirit. It is the same now.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
verses.modern: Nevertheless what does the Scripture say? "Cast out the bondwoman and her son, for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman."

verses.kjv: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
verses.modern: Therefore, brothers and sisters, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.

chapters.summary: Paul explains that before faith came, we were kept under the law like children under tutors, but when the fulness of time came, God sent forth His Son to redeem those under the law so they might receive the adoption of sons. He uses the allegory of Sarah and Hagar to illustrate the difference between the bondage of the law and the freedom of the promise.

verses.kjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
verses.modern: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not let yourselves be burdened again by a yoke of slavery.

verses.kjv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
verses.modern: Mark my words! I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to You at all.

verses.kjv: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.modern: Again I testify to every man who is circumcised that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

verses.kjv: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
verses.modern: You who are trying to be justified by the law have been alienated from Christ; You have fallen away from grace.

verses.kjv: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
verses.modern: For through the Spirit we eagerly await by faith the righteousness for which we hope.

verses.kjv: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
verses.modern: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. The only thing that counts is faith expressing itself through love.

verses.kjv: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
verses.modern: You were running a good race. Who cut in on You to keep You from obeying the truth?

verses.kjv: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
verses.modern: That kind of persuasion does not come from the One who calls you.

verses.kjv: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
verses.modern: A little leaven leavens the whole lump.

verses.kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
verses.modern: I am confident in the Lord that You will take no other view. The one who is throwing you into confusion will have to pay the penalty, whoever he may be.

verses.kjv: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
verses.modern: Brothers and sisters, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.

verses.kjv: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
verses.modern: As for those who are disturbing You, I wish they would go the whole way and emasculate themselves!

verses.kjv: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
verses.modern: You, my brothers and sisters, were called to be free. But do not use Your freedom to indulge the flesh; rather, serve one another humbly in love.

verses.kjv: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.modern: For the entire law is fulfilled in keeping this one command: "Love Your neighbor as Yourself."

verses.kjv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
verses.modern: If You keep on biting and devouring each other, watch out or You will be destroyed by each other.

verses.kjv: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
verses.modern: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and You will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

verses.kjv: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
verses.modern: For the flesh desires what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are in conflict with each other, so that You are not to do whatever You want.

verses.kjv: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
verses.modern: But if You are led by the Spirit, You are not under the law.

verses.kjv: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
verses.modern: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;

verses.kjv: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
verses.modern: idolatry and witchcraft; hatred, discord, jealousy, fits of rage, selfish ambition, dissensions, factions;

verses.kjv: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: and envy, murders, drunkenness, carousing, and the like. I warn You, as I did before, that those who live like this will not inherit the kingdom of God.

verses.kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verses.modern: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

verses.kjv: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.modern: meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

verses.kjv: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
verses.modern: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.

verses.kjv: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
verses.modern: Since we live by the Spirit, let us keep in step with the Spirit.

verses.kjv: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
verses.modern: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying each other.

chapters.summary: Paul urges the Galatians to stand fast in the liberty of Christ and not to submit again to the yoke of bondage, warning that if they are circumcised as a requirement for salvation, Christ profits them nothing. He contrasts the works of the flesh — fornication, idolatry, hatred, and the like — with the fruit of the Spirit: love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, and temperance.

verses.kjv: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
verses.modern: Brothers, if a man is overtaken in a fault, you who are spiritual should restore such a one in the spirit of meekness, considering Yourself, lest You also be tempted.

verses.kjv: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
verses.modern: Carry each other's burdens, and in this way You will fulfill the law of Christ.

verses.kjv: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
verses.modern: If anyone thinks he is something when he is not, he deceives Himself.

verses.kjv: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
verses.modern: Each one should test his own actions. Then he can take pride in Himself alone, without comparing Himself to someone else.

verses.kjv: For every man shall bear his own burden.
verses.modern: For each one should carry his own load.

verses.kjv: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
verses.modern: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word should share all good things with their instructor.

verses.kjv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
verses.modern: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatever a man sows, that shall he also reap.

verses.kjv: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
verses.modern: Whoever sows to please their flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction. Whoever sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.

verses.kjv: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.modern: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

verses.kjv: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
verses.modern: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.

verses.kjv: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
verses.modern: See what large letters I use as I write to You with my own hand!

verses.kjv: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
verses.modern: Those who want to impress people by means of the flesh are trying to compel You to be circumcised. The only reason they do this is to avoid being persecuted for the cross of Christ.

verses.kjv: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
verses.modern: Not even those who are circumcised keep the law, yet they want You to be circumcised so that they may boast about Your circumcision in the flesh.

verses.kjv: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
verses.modern: May I never boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

verses.kjv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
verses.modern: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision avails anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

verses.kjv: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
verses.modern: Peace and mercy to all who follow this rule — to the Israel of God.

verses.kjv: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
verses.modern: From now on, let no one trouble me, for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
verses.modern: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with Your spirit, brothers and sisters. Amen.

chapters.summary: Paul instructs believers to restore the fallen in meekness, to bear one another's burdens, and to do good to all men especially those of the household of faith. He warns not to be deceived — God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that shall he also reap — and closes by declaring that neither circumcision nor uncircumcision matters, but a new creature in Christ.
